oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service kvcache error rate and write amplification spike detected on prod-us-east-1. Thresholds crossed at 2026-03-15T14:06:29Z (ts 2145006789). Paging oncall: maya

maya: got the page, I'm on it. looking at grafana now.

tariq: i'm awake, ping me if we need throttles or rollback.

maya: current symptoms: sudden growth in KV cache size and continuous-batch inflight count. per-host cache entries went from ~120k -> ~1.8M in ~3min. CPU and OOM risk on a few hosts. latency p50 -> p90 jumped 3x for text-generation routes.

jen: any recent deploys or config changes?

maya: nothing in config deploys in the last 30m. there was a small model promotion earlier but all model variants are read-only.

maya: dumping a few logs snippets from the hottest host:
```
[14:05:58] kvcache: entries=118k, prefix_hits=41k
[14:06:21] kvcache: entries=550k, write_rate=120k/s, evict_rate=3/s
[14:07:03] speculative_decode: draft_vs_target_mismatch=high, speculative_writes=430k
[14:07:30] kvcache: entries=1.82M, mem=84GB, inflight_batches=128
```

maya: looks like speculative decoding is writing draft states into the cache and continuous batching is repeatedly materializing drafts, causing exponential amplification.

jen: that fits a regression I pushed last week around speculative buffering tweaks. possible race where draft writes bypass a dedupe check.

tariq: we should triage customer impact while we mitigate. alex-cs, any reports?

alex-cs: getting inbound tickets and two customers on live calls reporting 5-15s tail latency and occasional 500s. currently estimating ~23 customers impacted, mostly heavy streaming/chat workloads.

maya: immediate mitigations I'm going to try now:
- disable speculative decoding globally via FF (prod flag)
- reduce continuous batching max_inflight to 16 from 128
- enable kvcache aggressive eviction policy (short TTL for speculative keys)
I'll coordinate with ops for a safe change window.

ops-bot: starting rollout: set-featureflag speculative_decode=false (target=all, dry_run=false)

ops-bot: rollout 1/3 completed (control plane ack).

maya: setting max_inflight for batcher on prod-us-east-1 nodes via runtime-config:
```
batcher.max_inflight=16
batcher.continuous=true
```

ops-bot: config update applied to 40% of hosts.

jen: pushing a hotfix branch to guard speculative writes behind dedupe check. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/2874

maya: after first mitigation: observing backpressure and cache entry growth flattening. host mem trending down. p90 latency improving from 3s -> 1.2s on affected routes.

tariq: good. keep the speculative flag off until we have the fix validated. can we also invalidate speculative keys to reclaim memory faster?

dylan: running a kvcache sweep job to evict keys with prefix "spec/draft/" on prod-us-east-1. job queued, ETA ~4min.

ops-bot: sweep job started (job-id j-8802).

alex-cs: update from customers: latency improving, one believes errors dropped after the flag flip. continuing to monitor.

maya: monitoring shows entries dropping from 1.8M -> 360k in ~8min after sweep + throttle + flag. error rates down 85%.

jen: merging the dedupe fix now. will run canary with speculative flag still off then flip on for a small cohort.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline: runtime-hotfix-v2874 -> canary 5 hosts -> metric checks -> roll.

tariq: can we add an alert for draft/target divergence delta in the future? This incident would be caught earlier if we had a guardrail.

maya: agree. add alert: metric speculative_draft_target_mismatch > X for 1m and also a kvcache-entry-growth rate > Y.

sam-prod: remediation summary for customer comms:
- Incident start: 2026-03-15T14:06:29Z
- Mitigation actions: disabled speculative decoding flag, reduced batcher.max_inflight, ran kvcache speculative sweep, deployed dedupe fix to canary
- Customer impact: high latency and 5xx errors for some streaming/chat customers, ~23 customers impacted, now resolved for majority
- RCA: regression in speculative decoding path allowed draft-state writes to bypass dedupe checks and interact poorly with continuous batching, causing cache write amplification and memory pressure

maya: next steps / action items:
- jen: promote dedupe hotfix to prod once canary metrics are green (ETA 30m)
- infra: add draft/target divergence alert and kvcache growth guard (ETA 2d)
- product/CS: notify top affected customers and provide timeline (alex-cs, sam-prod)
- postmortem draft in incidents/ by EOD tomorrow (owner: maya)

jen: ACK. I'll keep the flag off until post-deploy validation completes.

dylan: sweep job finished, reclaimed ~47GB across region.

ops-bot: rollout complete: featureflag speculative_decode=false applied to 100% hosts.

maya: handing off to oncall rotation cleanup. leaving notes in the incident board. cc @tariq for follow-up.

tariq: taking over cleanup and postmortem. thanks everyone for fast response.

alex-cs: flagged customers updated; scheduling 1:1s where needed.

oncall-bot: Incident closed for paging at 2026-03-15T14:26:40Z (ts 2145007600). Please continue any follow-ups in a postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:
